grammar.explanation: 并不 emphasises that a proposed inference does not hold. It can reject equivalence without asserting every possible opposite.

examples.zh: 没有到场，并不说明没有需要。
examples.py: méi yǒu dào chǎng , bìng bù shuō míng méi yǒu xū yào .
examples.en: Not attending does not establish no need.

examples.zh: 支持继续试，并不等于支持每天延长。
examples.py: zhī chí jì xù shì , bìng bù děng yú zhī chí měi tiān yán cháng .
examples.en: Supporting further trial is not supporting extension every day.

commonMistakes.wrong: 没有到场，并不说明没有需要，所以一定每天都需要。
commonMistakes.right: 没有到场，并不说明没有需要。
commonMistakes.why: Rejecting one inference does not establish a different universal claim.

grammar.purpose: Hold a result across a hypothetical condition
grammar.explanation: 即使 introduces a hypothetical or extreme condition; 也 maintains the second clause. Compare actual concessions introduced by 尽管.

examples.zh: 即使再试四周，也要先确认人手。
examples.py: jí shǐ zài shì sì zhōu , yě yào xiān què rèn rén shǒu .
examples.en: Even if we trial another four weeks, we still need to confirm staffing.

examples.zh: 即使我这周不来，也想知道以后的安排。
examples.py: jí shǐ wǒ zhè zhōu bù lái , yě xiǎng zhī dào yǐ hòu de ān pái .
examples.en: Even if I don’t come this week, I want to know later arrangements.

commonMistakes.wrong: 即使再试四周，所以不用确认人手。
commonMistakes.right: 即使再试四周，也要先确认人手。
commonMistakes.why: The maintained requirement belongs after 也.

grammar.explanation: The pattern states dependence in the present argument; do not confuse necessary support with a sufficient guarantee of every outcome.

examples.zh: 没有总人数，就没有计算比重的依据。
examples.py: méi yǒu zǒng rén shù , jiù méi yǒu jì suàn bǐ zhòng de yī jù .
examples.en: Without a total population there is no basis for the proportion.

examples.zh: 没有人关门，就没有继续试办的安排。
examples.py: méi yǒu rén guān mén , jiù méi yǒu jì xù shì bàn de ān pái .
examples.en: Without someone to close up there is no arrangement for continuing.

commonMistakes.wrong: 有总人数，就证明每个人都喜欢。
commonMistakes.right: 没有总人数，就没有计算比重的依据。
commonMistakes.why: Knowing a denominator permits a proportion, not a claim about attitudes.

grammar.explanation: The concession accepts the observed fact while limiting the larger claim.

examples.zh: 尽管有人到场，但还不知道多少是第一次来。
examples.py: jǐn guǎn yǒu rén dào chǎng , dàn hái bù zhī dào duō shao shì dì yī cì lái .
examples.en: Although people attended, we don’t know how many were first-time visitors.

examples.zh: 尽管我赞成继续，但不要求马上每天延长。
examples.py: jǐn guǎn wǒ zàn chéng jì xù , dàn bú yào qiú mǎ shàng měi tiān yán cháng .
examples.en: Although I favour continuing, I don’t demand daily extension immediately.

commonMistakes.wrong: 尽管有人到场，但所以人人一定都来了。
commonMistakes.right: 尽管有人到场，但还不知道多少是第一次来。
commonMistakes.why: A concession should preserve rather than erase the limit.

grammar.purpose: Identify the basis for a claim
grammar.explanation: 凭 can introduce evidence or a basis; 依据 is common in organised explanation. Specify what that basis does and does not establish.

examples.zh: 凭这四周的记录，还不能决定所有日子。
examples.py: píng zhè sì zhōu de jì lù , hái bù néng jué dìng suǒ yǒu rì zi .
examples.en: These four weeks’ records do not settle every day.

examples.zh: 我们依据到访记录和意见作评估。
examples.py: wǒ men yī jù dào fǎng jì lù hé yì jiàn zuò píng gū .
examples.en: We evaluate using visit records and feedback.

commonMistakes.wrong: 凭四周记录，就知道每位居民全部的安排。
commonMistakes.right: 凭这四周的记录，还不能决定所有日子。
commonMistakes.why: The record’s scope is limited to this pilot.

lines.zh: 你看了小图书馆延长时间的那篇文章吗？
lines.py: nǐ kàn le xiǎo tú shū guǎn yán cháng shí jiān de nà piān wén zhāng ma ?
lines.en: Did you read the article about the small library extending its hours?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 看了。我希望周四能继续开到八点，下班后才来得及。
lines.py: kàn le . wǒ xī wàng zhōu sì néng jì xù kāi dào bā diǎn , xià bān hòu cái lái de jí .
lines.en: Yes. I hope Thursdays continue until eight; I can only get there after work.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 文章说四周共六十四人次，你觉得够吗？
lines.py: wén zhāng shuō sì zhōu gòng liù shí sì rén cì , nǐ jué de gòu ma ?
lines.en: It says sixty-four visits over four weeks. Is that enough, in your view?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 够不够要看什么目的吧，至少不是完全没人来。
lines.py: gòu bù gòu yào kàn shén me mù dì ba , zhì shǎo bù shì wán quán méi rén lái .
lines.en: Enough for what purpose? At least it wasn’t entirely unused.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 但也不是六十四个不同的人。
lines.py: dàn yě bù shì liù shí sì gè bù tóng de rén .
lines.en: But not necessarily sixty-four different people.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，我就去了三次，不能把我算成三个居民。
lines.py: duì , wǒ jiù qù le sān cì , bù néng bǎ wǒ suàn chéng sān gè jū mín .
lines.en: Right. I went three times; that doesn’t make me three residents.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 有人评论说，大家都喜欢聊天，应该改成交流活动。
lines.py: yǒu rén píng lùn shuō , dà jiā dōu xǐ huān liáo tiān , yīng gāi gǎi chéng jiāo liú huó dòng .
lines.en: Someone commented that everyone likes chatting, so it should become a discussion event.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我可不是，我去是想安静看书。
lines.py: wǒ kě bú shì , wǒ qù shì xiǎng ān jìng kàn shū .
lines.en: I don’t. I go to read quietly.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 所以“大家都喜欢”说得太满了。
lines.py: suǒ yǐ dà jiā dōu xǐ huān shuō de tài mǎn le .
lines.en: So “everyone likes it” goes too far.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 是啊。我想聊天的时候，会另外找地方。
lines.py: shì a . wǒ xiǎng liáo tiān de shí hou , huì lìng wài zhǎo dì fāng .
lines.en: Yes. When I want to talk, I go somewhere else.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你会要求每天都延长吗？
lines.py: nǐ huì yāo qiú měi tiān dōu yán cháng ma ?
lines.en: Would you ask for longer hours every day?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 现在不敢这么说。先把周四安排好，再看看别的日子。
lines.py: xiàn zài bù gǎn zhè me shuō . xiān bǎ zhōu sì ān pái hǎo , zài kàn kàn bié de rì zi .
lines.en: Not at this stage. Settle Thursdays first, then look at other days.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 负责关门的两个人，每次都多留两小时。
lines.py: fù zé guān mén de liǎng gè rén , měi cì dōu duō liú liǎng xiǎo shí .
lines.en: The two people closing up each stay two extra hours.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 这也要算进去。不能只问来的人方便不方便。
lines.py: zhè yě yào suàn jìn qù . bù néng zhǐ wèn lái de rén fāng biàn bù fāng biàn .
lines.en: That matters too. We can’t consider only convenience for visitors.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 如果他们下个月没空呢？
lines.py: rú guǒ tā men xià gè yuè méi kōng ne ?
lines.en: What if they are unavailable next month?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 就先确认有没有别人接，不要先发继续开放的通知。
lines.py: jiù xiān què rèn yǒu méi yǒu bié ren jiē , bú yào xiān fā jì xù kāi fàng de tōng zhī .
lines.en: Check for someone to take over before announcing continued opening.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 看来你的立场是继续试，不是保证马上扩大。
lines.py: kàn lái nǐ de lì chǎng shì jì xù shì , bù shì bǎo zhèng mǎ shàng kuò dà .
lines.en: So your position is to keep trying, not guarantee immediate expansion.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对。支持这个办法，也可以说清还不知道什么。
lines.py: duì . zhī chí zhè gè bàn fǎ , yě kě yǐ shuō qīng hái bù zhī dào shén me .
lines.en: Right. Supporting it can include stating what we still don’t know.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这个社区的小图书馆原来每天下午六点关闭。四周试办中，周四延长到晚上八点，其他日子的时间不变。我支持再试四周，因为下班以后来的人确实找到了一段能读书的时间。不过，我的立场不是马上每天都开到八点，也不是说不来的人都不喜欢读书。这两个更大的判断，需要另外的依据。
lines.py: zhè gè shè qū de xiǎo tú shū guǎn yuán lái měi tiān xià wǔ liù diǎn guān bì . sì zhōu shì bàn zhōng , zhōu sì yán cháng dào wǎn shang bā diǎn , qí tā rì zi de shí jiān bù biàn . wǒ zhī chí zài shì sì zhōu , yīn wèi xià bān yǐ hòu lái de rén què shí zhǎo dào le yī duàn néng dú shū de shí jiān . bù guò , wǒ de lì chǎng bù shì mǎ shàng měi tiān dōu kāi dào bā diǎn , yě bù shì shuō bù lái de rén dōu bù xǐ huān dú shū . zhè liǎng gè gèng dà de pàn duàn , xū yào lìng wài de yī jù .
lines.en: The community’s small library normally closed at six. A four-week pilot extended Thursdays to eight, with other days unchanged. I support another four weeks because some workers found time to read, but not immediate daily extension or a claim that non-attendees dislike reading. Those broader judgments need separate support.

lines.zh: 工作人员把四个周四的晚间到访分别记为十八、二十、十二和十四人次，共六十四人次。这些记录不包括负责的人。人次说明发生了多少次到访，不等于有六十四个不同的居民。一个人来了三次，就贡献三人次；如果要知道有多少不同的人，需要另一种记录，这次没有做。
lines.py: gōng zuò rén yuán bǎ sì gè zhōu sì de wǎn jiān dào fǎng fēn bié jì wèi shí bā , èr shí , shí èr hé shí sì rén cì , gòng liù shí sì rén cì . zhè xiē jì lù bù bāo kuò fù zé de rén . rén cì shuō míng fā shēng le duō shao cì dào fǎng , bù děng yú yǒu liù shí sì gè bù tóng de jū mín . yī gè rén lái le sān cì , jiù gòng xiàn sān rén cì ; rú guǒ yào zhī dào yǒu duō shao bù tóng de rén , xū yào lìng yī zhǒng jì lù , zhè cì méi yǒu zuò .
lines.en: The four Thursday evenings recorded eighteen, twenty, twelve and fourteen visitor entries, sixty-four total, excluding staff. These are visits rather than sixty-four distinct residents: one person attending three times contributes three. Unique attendance would require a different record that wasn’t kept.

lines.zh: 有人说六十四太少，也有人说已经很多。我觉得先问清比较的对象，才能讨论这个差距。小厅只有三十个座位，不能拿一个晚上来的人数，直接和全社区的居民人数比较，再决定所有人的需要。记录里也没有写谁在外地、谁那个晚上要照顾家人，所以没有到场，并不能独自说明这个时间对他们没有价值。
lines.py: yǒu rén shuō liù shí sì tài shǎo , yě yǒu rén shuō yǐ jīng hěn duō . wǒ jué de xiān wèn qīng bǐ jiào de duì xiàng , cái néng tǎo lùn zhè gè chā jù . xiǎo tīng zhǐ yǒu sān shí gè zuò wèi , bù néng ná yī gè wǎn shang lái de rén shù , zhí jiē hé quán shè qū de jū mín rén shù bǐ jiào , zài jué dìng suǒ yǒu rén de xū yào . jì lù lǐ yě méi yǒu xiě shéi zài wài dì , shéi nà gè wǎn shang yào zhào gù jiā rén , suǒ yǐ méi yǒu dào chǎng , bìng bù néng dú zì shuō míng zhè gè shí jiān duì tā men méi yǒu jià zhí .
lines.en: Some judged sixty-four low, others high. We need to establish the comparison before interpreting a gap. The hall’s thirty seats and one evening’s attendance cannot directly represent the needs of the whole community. Records don’t show travel or caregiving conflicts, so absence alone cannot establish that the hours had no value.

lines.zh: 延长开放不是没有成本。两位负责的人每次多留两小时，四周合起来是十六小时的人员时间，整理和关门也在这段时间里。这个数字不是两个人各自留了十六小时，更不是每位居民都花了十六小时。下个月能不能继续，先要问两个人的安排，有没有别人接手，不能只看到访者方便，就替负责的人答应。
lines.py: yán cháng kāi fàng bù shì méi yǒu chéng běn . liǎng wèi fù zé de rén měi cì duō liú liǎng xiǎo shí , sì zhōu hé qǐ lái shì shí liù xiǎo shí de rén yuán shí jiān , zhěng lǐ hé guān mén yě zài zhè duàn shí jiān lǐ . zhè gè shù zì bù shì liǎng gè rén gè zì liú le shí liù xiǎo shí , gèng bù shì měi wèi jū mín dōu huā le shí liù xiǎo shí . xià gè yuè néng bù néng jì xù , xiān yào wèn liǎng gè rén de ān pái , yǒu méi yǒu bié ren jiē shǒu , bù néng zhǐ kàn dào fǎng zhě fāng biàn , jiù tì fù zé de rén dā yìng .
lines.en: Two staff each stayed two extra hours per evening: sixteen staff-hours across four weeks, including tidying and closing. It is not sixteen hours for each person or each resident. Next month depends on availability and potential replacements, not a promise made for staff solely because visitors benefit.

lines.zh: 在评论里，有人建议把晚间改成交流活动，说一起聊天更能吸引人。我的主观感受正好不同：我下班以后想有一个安静地方，把没读完的几页读完。还有人愿意来讨论，我不认为他们错了；但在一个小厅里，两种活动同时进行，会有声音的矛盾。能否另找时间或地点，要先问场地安排，不能只把所有人放进去就当作两种需要都满足。
lines.py: zài píng lùn lǐ , yǒu rén jiàn yì bǎ wǎn jiān gǎi chéng jiāo liú huó dòng , shuō yì qǐ liáo tiān gèng néng xī yǐn rén . wǒ de zhǔ guān gǎn shòu zhèng hǎo bù tóng : wǒ xià bān yǐ hòu xiǎng yǒu yī gè ān jìng dì fāng , bǎ méi dú wán de jǐ yè dú wán . hái yǒu rén yuàn yì lái tǎo lùn , wǒ bù rèn wéi tā men cuò le ; dàn zài yī gè xiǎo tīng lǐ , liǎng zhǒng huó dòng tóng shí jìn xíng , huì yǒu shēng yīn de máo dùn . néng fǒu lìng zhǎo shí jiān huò dì diǎn , yào xiān wèn chǎng dì ān pái , bù néng zhǐ bǎ suǒ yǒu rén fàng jìn qù jiù dàng zuò liǎng zhǒng xū yào dōu mǎn zú .
lines.en: One comment proposed discussion to attract people. My own preference is a quiet place to finish reading after work. Others may want conversation too, but simultaneous activities in one small hall create noise conflict. A separate time or space needs checking; simply combining everyone doesn’t satisfy both needs.

lines.zh: 我也担心，只收集来的人意见，会缺乏没来的群体的声音。如果他们说交通不方便，延长两小时可能没有解决那个问题；如果有人只在周二有空，也不能说周四的成效已经替他解决了。可以在原来的公告旁边留一个反馈办法，让愿意的人说明时间和原因，不强迫任何人解释自己的全部生活。
lines.py: wǒ yě dān xīn , zhǐ shōu jí lái de rén yì jiàn , huì quē fá méi lái de qún tǐ de shēng yīn . rú guǒ tā men shuō jiāo tōng bù fāng biàn , yán cháng liǎng xiǎo shí kě néng méi yǒu jiě jué nà gè wèn tí ; rú guǒ yǒu rén zhǐ zài zhōu èr yǒu kōng , yě bù néng shuō zhōu sì de chéng xiào yǐ jīng tì tā jiě jué le . kě yǐ zài yuán lái de gōng gào páng biān liú yī gè fǎn kuì bàn fǎ , ràng yuàn yì de rén shuō míng shí jiān hé yuán yīn , bù qiǎng pò rèn hé rén jiě shì zì jǐ de quán bù shēng huó .
lines.en: Only asking attendees leaves non-attendees’ views missing. Longer hours may not solve travel difficulty or a Tuesday-only schedule. A feedback channel by the existing notice could invite timing and reasons without demanding accounts of everyone’s whole life.

lines.zh: 因此，我建议继续周四四周，把到访次数、安静阅读的情况和负责人的时间分别记下来。一次人多不算每次都好，一次下雨人少也不该直接终止。我们还不能排除天气和不同活动的影响，可以把情况写清，再作评估。继续试是为了检验安排能不能持续，不是先把想要的结论写好，再找数字装进去。
lines.py: yīn cǐ , wǒ jiàn yì jì xù zhōu sì sì zhōu , bǎ dào fǎng cì shù , ān jìng yuè dú de qíng kuàng hé fù zé rén de shí jiān fēn bié jì xià lái . yī cì rén duō bù suàn měi cì dōu hǎo , yī cì xià yǔ rén shǎo yě bù gāi zhí jiē zhōng zhǐ . wǒ men hái bù néng pái chú tiān qì hé bù tóng huó dòng de yǐng xiǎng , kě yǐ bǎ qíng kuàng xiě qīng , zài zuò píng gū . jì xù shì shì wèi le jiǎn yàn ān pái néng bù néng chí xù , bù shì xiān bǎ xiǎng yào de jié lùn xiě hǎo , zài zhǎo shù zì zhuāng jìn qù .
lines.en: I propose four more Thursdays, recording visits, quiet reading and staffing time separately. One busy evening doesn’t prove all evenings work; one rainy low-attendance evening shouldn’t alone end the trial. Weather and other events remain possible influences. Continued testing should examine sustainability rather than fit numbers into a predetermined conclusion.

lines.zh: 这个建议保留了我的期望，也承认它的限制。我希望下班以后有地方读，并愿意提前收好书，不让关门的人不断等。以后如果证据支持扩大，再讨论其他日子；如果人员时间不够，就先缩小或暂停。把支持说得有条件，不会使它变成反对，反而让下一步可以具体地问、具体地做。
lines.py: zhè gè jiàn yì bǎo liú le wǒ de qī wàng , yě chéng rèn tā de xiàn zhì . wǒ xī wàng xià bān yǐ hòu yǒu dì fāng dú , bìng yuàn yì tí qián shōu hǎo shū , bù ràng guān mén de rén bù duàn děng . yǐ hòu rú guǒ zhèng jù zhī chí kuò dà , zài tǎo lùn qí tā rì zi ; rú guǒ rén yuán shí jiān bù gòu , jiù xiān suō xiǎo huò zàn tíng . bǎ zhī chí shuō de yǒu tiáo jiàn , bù huì shǐ tā biàn chéng fǎn duì , fǎn ér ràng xià yī bù kě yǐ jù tǐ de wèn , jù tǐ de zuò .
lines.en: I hope for a place after work and will pack before closing. Expansion can be discussed if supported; inadequate staffing may require reducing or pausing hours. Conditional support remains support, while making the next steps concrete.

choices: Four more Thursdays with several separate checks
Permanent daily extension based solely on one total
Closing because one rainy evening was less busy
questions.answer: Four more Thursdays with several separate checks

choices: Combined additional staff-hours across four weeks
Sixteen extra hours for each of two staff every evening
Time spent by every visitor
questions.answer: Combined additional staff-hours across four weeks

questions.q: What does sixty-four visits not tell us?
choices: The number of distinct residents attending
That visits were recorded
That the four counts add to sixty-four

extraReadings.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.

lines.zh: 你一晚上看了多少页？
lines.py: nǐ yī wǎn shang kàn le duō shao yè ?
lines.en: How many pages did you read this evening?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 三页。
lines.py: sān yè .
lines.en: Three.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我看了二十页。
lines.py: wǒ kàn le èr shí yè .
lines.en: I read twenty.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你的书一页只有两句话吧？
lines.py: nǐ de shū yī yè zhǐ yǒu liǎng jù huà ba ?
lines.en: Does your book have only two sentences per page?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 对，还有很大的画。
lines.py: duì , hái yǒu hěn dà de huà .
lines.en: Yes, and large pictures.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那别光比页数。
lines.py: nà bié guāng bǐ yè shù .

lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你的三页是不是一页全是字？
lines.py: nǐ de sān yè shì bú shì yī yè quán shì zì ?

lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 是，还来回看了两次。
lines.py: shì , hái lái huí kàn le liǎng cì .
lines.en: Yes, and I read them twice.

lines.zh: 好，我们都各自看明白一点了。
lines.py: hǎo , wǒ men dōu gè zì kàn míng bái yī diǎn le .
lines.en: Okay, we each understood a little more.

lines.zh: 我还没完全明白，最后一句要再想。
lines.py: wǒ hái méi wán quán míng bái , zuì hòu yī jù yào zài xiǎng .

lines.zh: 那我先出去，你留在这里想。
lines.py: nà wǒ xiān chū qù , nǐ liú zài zhè lǐ xiǎng .

lines.zh: 八点关门以前，我一定收好书。
lines.py: bā diǎn guān mén yǐ qián , wǒ yí dìng shōu hǎo shū .

extraReadings.title: Evidence and a position: words in context
extraReadings.titleZh: 有依据，也有立场 · 词语练习
extraReadings.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
extraReadings.purpose: Retrieve these words in separate everyday situations.

lines.zh: 我喜欢晚上读，但这是主观感受。
lines.py: wǒ xǐ huān wǎn shang dú , dàn zhè shì zhǔ guān gǎn shòu .
lines.en: I like evening reading, but that is a subjective experience.

lines.zh: 她提醒我，不要把主观印象当成人数。
lines.py: tā tí xǐng wǒ , bú yào bǎ zhǔ guān yìn xiàng dàng chéng rén shù .
lines.en: She reminded me not to treat a subjective impression as a count.

lines.zh: 我的立场是先继续试，不是马上每天延长。
lines.py: wǒ de lì chǎng shì xiān jì xù shì , bù shì mǎ shàng měi tiān yán cháng .
lines.en: My position is to continue the trial, not extend every day immediately.

lines.zh: 他解释了自己的立场，也听了对方的理由。
lines.py: tā jiě shì le zì jǐ de lì chǎng , yě tīng le duì fāng de lǐ yóu .
lines.en: He explained his position and listened to the other side’s reasons.

lines.zh: 从有人来跳到人人需要，这个逻辑不成立。
lines.py: cóng yǒu rén lái tiào dào rén rén xū yào , zhè gè luó jí bù chéng lì .
lines.en: The logic of jumping from some attendance to universal need doesn’t hold.

lines.zh: 这个故事的时间逻辑有问题。
lines.py: zhè gè gù shì de shí jiān luó jí yǒu wèn tí .
lines.en: The chronology of this story has a logical problem.

lines.zh: 想安静读和想聊天，在同一个小厅里有矛盾。
lines.py: xiǎng ān jìng dú hé xiǎng liáo tiān , zài tóng yī gè xiǎo tīng lǐ yǒu máo dùn .
lines.en: Quiet reading and conversation conflict in the same small hall.

lines.zh: 他说的两个时间互相矛盾。
lines.py: tā shuō de liǎng gè shí jiān hù xiāng máo dùn .
lines.en: The two times he gave contradict each other.

lines.zh: 报名表间接告诉我们有人有兴趣，不说明一定到场。
lines.py: bào míng biǎo jiàn jiē gào sù wǒ men yǒu rén yǒu xìng qù , bù shuō míng yí dìng dào chǎng .
lines.en: Registration indirectly indicates interest, not certain attendance.

lines.zh: 我是间接听到这个消息的，没有见到本人。
lines.py: wǒ shì jiàn jiē tīng dào zhè gè xiāo xī de , méi yǒu jiàn dào běn rén .
lines.en: I heard this news indirectly, without seeing the person.

lines.zh: 还不能排除天气影响人数。
lines.py: hái bù néng pái chú tiān qì yǐng xiǎng rén shù .
lines.en: We cannot yet rule out the weather affecting attendance.

lines.zh: 先排除时间冲突，再选地点。
lines.py: xiān pái chú shí jiān chōng tū , zài xuǎn dì diǎn .
lines.en: Rule out scheduling conflicts before choosing the venue.

lines.zh: 可以控制一次试办的时长，不能控制谁一定来。
lines.py: kě yǐ kòng zhì yī cì shì bàn de shí zhǎng , bù néng kòng zhì shéi yí dìng lái .
lines.en: We can control a trial’s duration, not who will definitely attend.

lines.zh: 她把说话的声音控制得很小。
lines.py: tā bǎ shuō huà de shēng yīn kòng zhì de hěn xiǎo .
lines.en: She kept her speaking voice very quiet.

lines.zh: 这些意见要加以讨论，不是直接删掉。
lines.py: zhè xiē yì jiàn yào jiā yǐ tǎo lùn , bù shì zhí jiē shān diào .
lines.en: These views need to be discussed, not simply deleted.

lines.zh: 发现的问题已经加以说明。
lines.py: fā xiàn de wèn tí yǐ jīng jiā yǐ shuō míng .
lines.en: The problems found have been explained.

lines.zh: 人数是一个依据，但不是全部。
lines.py: rén shù shì yī gè yī jù , dàn bù shì quán bù .
lines.en: Attendance is one basis, not the whole picture.

lines.zh: 他依据原来的记录核对日期。
lines.py: tā yī jù yuán lái de jì lù hé duì rì qī .
lines.en: He checked dates against the original record.

lines.zh: 我不同意“少来一次就是不需要”这个说法。
lines.py: wǒ bù tóng yì shǎo lái yī cì jiù shì bù xū yào zhè gè shuō fǎ .
lines.en: I disagree with the claim that missing one visit means no need.

lines.zh: 请把两种说法都记下来。
lines.py: qǐng bǎ liǎng zhǒng shuō fǎ dōu jì xià lái .
lines.en: Please record both accounts.

lines.zh: 继续试办的前提是有人能负责关门。
lines.py: jì xù shì bàn de qián tí shì yǒu rén néng fù zé guān mén .
lines.en: Continuing the pilot requires someone to close up.

lines.zh: 这个建议的前提还没有确认。
lines.py: zhè gè jiàn yì de qián tí hái méi yǒu què rèn .
lines.en: The premise of this suggestion has not been confirmed.

lines.zh: 四周以后，再评估延长时间的安排。
lines.py: sì zhōu yǐ hòu , zài píng gū yán cháng shí jiān de ān pái .
lines.en: Evaluate the extended hours after four weeks.

lines.zh: 评估不能只看一次最好结果。
lines.py: píng gū bù néng zhǐ kàn yī cì zuì hǎo jié guǒ .
lines.en: An evaluation cannot look only at one best result.

lines.zh: 这条评论提出了安静的问题。
lines.py: zhè tiáo píng lùn tí chū le ān jìng de wèn tí .
lines.en: This comment raises the issue of quiet.

lines.zh: 她读完文章，写了一条简短评论。
lines.py: tā dú wán wén zhāng , xiě le yī tiáo jiǎn duǎn píng lùn .
lines.en: After reading the article she wrote a short comment.

lines.zh: 我期望方便一些，不是要求随时开门。
lines.py: wǒ qī wàng fāng biàn yī xiē , bù shì yāo qiú suí shí kāi mén .
lines.en: I hope for more convenience, not opening at any time.

lines.zh: 大家对结尾的期望不一样。
lines.py: dà jiā duì jié wěi de qī wàng bù yī yàng .
lines.en: People have different expectations of the ending.

lines.zh: 我们想改变下班以后无处读书的局面。
lines.py: wǒ men xiǎng gǎi biàn xià bān yǐ hòu wú chù dú shū de jú miàn .
lines.en: We want to change the lack of a reading place after work.

lines.zh: 一句解释改变了争论的局面。
lines.py: yī jù jiě shì gǎi biàn le zhēng lùn de jú miàn .
lines.en: An explanation changed the course of the argument.

lines.zh: 没有问不来的人，记录就缺乏他们的意见。
lines.py: méi yǒu wèn bù lái de rén , jì lù jiù quē fá tā men de yì jiàn .
lines.en: Without asking non-attendees, the record lacks their views.

lines.zh: 这段解释缺乏具体例子。
lines.py: zhè duàn jiě shì quē fá jù tǐ lì zi .
lines.en: This explanation lacks concrete examples.

lines.zh: 不同群体需要的时间可能不同。
lines.py: bù tóng qún tǐ xū yào de shí jiān kě néng bù tóng .
lines.en: Different groups may need different hours.

lines.zh: 不能用一个人代表整个群体。
lines.py: bù néng yòng yī gè rén dài biǎo zhěng gè qún tǐ .
lines.en: One person cannot stand for a whole group.

lines.zh: 不知道总人数，就算不出这个比重。
lines.py: bù zhī dào zǒng rén shù , jiù suàn bù chū zhè gè bǐ zhòng .
lines.en: Without the total population we cannot calculate this proportion.

lines.zh: 这次交通费在总费用中的比重更大。
lines.py: zhè cì jiāo tōng fèi zài zǒng fèi yòng zhōng de bǐ zhòng gèng dà .
lines.en: Travel makes up a larger share of the total cost this time.

lines.zh: 多开两小时，也有整理和关门的成本。
lines.py: duō kāi liǎng xiǎo shí , yě yǒu zhěng lǐ hé guān mén de chéng běn .
lines.en: Two additional hours also involve tidying and closing costs.

lines.zh: 便宜的材料不一定让总成本下降。
lines.py: pián yi de cái liào bù yí dìng ràng zǒng chéng běn xià jiàng .
lines.en: Cheap material doesn’t necessarily reduce total cost.

lines.zh: 有人找到读书时间，是一个成效，但还要继续看。
lines.py: yǒu rén zhǎo dào dú shū shí jiān , shì yī gè chéng xiào , dàn hái yào jì xù kàn .
lines.en: Some finding time to read is a benefit, but further observation is needed.

lines.zh: 我们下周再看看这个办法的成效。
lines.py: wǒ men xià zhōu zài kàn kàn zhè gè bàn fǎ de chéng xiào .
lines.en: We will look again at this method’s results next week.

lines.zh: 我先大致介绍四周的记录。
lines.py: wǒ xiān dà zhì jiè shào sì zhōu de jì lù .
lines.en: I will first give a broad account of the four-week records.

lines.zh: 路线大致相同，最后一段不同。
lines.py: lù xiàn dà zhì xiāng tóng , zuì hòu yī duàn bù tóng .
lines.en: The routes are broadly the same, but differ at the end.

lines.zh: 只看总人数，这个依据太单一。
lines.py: zhǐ kàn zǒng rén shù , zhè gè yī jù tài dān yī .
lines.en: Total attendance alone is too one-dimensional a basis.

lines.zh: 她不想只做单一类型的工作。
lines.py: tā bù xiǎng zhǐ zuò dān yī lèi xíng de gōng zuò .
lines.en: She doesn’t want to do only one type of work.

lines.zh: 想来的时间和开放时间有差距。
lines.py: xiǎng lái de shí jiān hé kāi fàng shí jiān yǒu chā jù .
lines.en: There is a gap between desired visiting times and opening hours.

lines.zh: 练习的表现和实际比赛还有差距。
lines.py: liàn xí de biǎo xiàn hé shí jì bǐ sài hái yǒu chā jù .
lines.en: There is still a gap between practice performance and competition.

lines.zh: 再试四周，可以检验这个安排能不能持续。
lines.py: zài shì sì zhōu , kě yǐ jiǎn yàn zhè gè ān pái néng bù néng chí xù .
lines.en: Another four-week trial can test whether this arrangement can continue.

lines.zh: 这一次检验发现了两个问题。
lines.py: zhè yī cì jiǎn yàn fā xiàn le liǎng gè wèn tí .
lines.en: This examination found two problems.

lines.zh: 我也是这个小图书馆的读者，但没有参加四周的周四晚间试办。不是因为我不需要晚上读书，而是周四有课，结束以后已经八点半。看到有人写“没有来就没有需要”，我想说明自己的情况。开放到八点，对一些人很合适，对我却还是有半小时的差距；这个差距不是一句“不够积极”能消除的。
lines.py: wǒ yě shì zhè gè xiǎo tú shū guǎn de dú zhě , dàn méi yǒu cān jiā sì zhōu de zhōu sì wǎn jiān shì bàn . bù shì yīn wèi wǒ bù xū yào wǎn shang dú shū , ér shì zhōu sì yǒu kè , jié shù yǐ hòu yǐ jīng bā diǎn bàn . kàn dào yǒu rén xiě méi yǒu lái jiù méi yǒu xū yào , wǒ xiǎng shuō míng zì jǐ de qíng kuàng . kāi fàng dào bā diǎn , duì yī xiē rén hěn hé shì , duì wǒ què hái shi yǒu bàn xiǎo shí de chā jù ; zhè gè chā jù bù shì yī jù bù gòu jī jí néng xiāo chú de .
lines.en: I use the small library but didn’t attend the Thursday pilot because class ends at 8:30. Absence doesn’t mean no need for evening reading. Closing at eight suits some but leaves a half-hour gap for me, not a problem solved by calling me insufficiently keen.

lines.zh: 我没有因此要求立刻延长到九点。听到两位工作人员每次已经多留两小时，我知道他们也有自己的安排。我希望以后评估时，能把像我这样没到场的人意见加进去，而不是由来得最多的人替大家作决定。也许别的日子更合适，也许根本没有足够人手，两个可能都需要先问。
lines.py: wǒ méi yǒu yīn cǐ yāo qiú lì kè yán cháng dào jiǔ diǎn . tīng dào liǎng wèi gōng zuò rén yuán měi cì yǐ jīng duō liú liǎng xiǎo shí , wǒ zhī dào tā men yě yǒu zì jǐ de ān pái . wǒ xī wàng yǐ hòu píng gū shí , néng bǎ xiàng wǒ zhè yàng méi dào chǎng de rén yì jiàn jiā jìn qù , ér bù shì yóu lái de zuì duō de rén tì dà jiā zuò jué dìng . yě xǔ bié de rì zi gèng hé shì , yě xǔ gēn běn méi yǒu zú gòu rén shǒu , liǎng gè kě néng dōu xū yào xiān wèn .
lines.en: I am not demanding immediate nine-o’clock closing. The two staff already stay two extra hours and have their own schedules. I want non-attendee views included, rather than frequent visitors deciding for all. Another day might suit or staffing might be insufficient; both need asking.

lines.zh: 文章里的六十四人次，让我知道这个时间不是没人用。但是我不知道其中多少人只来一次、多少人常来，也不能算出他们在所有读者中的比重。总读者有多少，这次记录没有提供。缺了这个数字，就不能把六十四直接叫作大多数，或者反过来叫作没有价值的一小群人。
lines.py: wén zhāng lǐ de liù shí sì rén cì , ràng wǒ zhī dào zhè gè shí jiān bù shì méi rén yòng . dàn shì wǒ bù zhī dào qí zhōng duō shao rén zhǐ lái yī cì , duō shao rén cháng lái , yě bù néng suàn chū tā men zài suǒ yǒu dú zhě zhōng de bǐ zhòng . zǒng dú zhě yǒu duō shao , zhè cì jì lù méi yǒu tí gōng . quē le zhè gè shù zì , jiù bù néng bǎ liù shí sì zhí jiē jiào zuò dà duō shù , huò zhě fǎn guò lái jiào zuò méi yǒu jià zhí de yī xiǎo qún rén .
lines.en: Sixty-four visits show use, but don’t reveal unique or repeat visitors or their share of all readers. Total readership is not given. The figure cannot establish either a majority or a supposedly worthless small minority.

lines.zh: 有一个评论建议换成交流活动。我其实喜欢聊书，也想认识新朋友，可是如果好不容易找到安静时间，旁边一直有人说话，我就难以看下去。这并不矛盾：同一个人在不同时间，也可以想要不同活动。我愿意周末参加读书交流，但下课以后的短时间，常常只想安静读一会儿。
lines.py: yǒu yī gè píng lùn jiàn yì huàn chéng jiāo liú huó dòng . wǒ qí shí xǐ huān liáo shū , yě xiǎng rèn shi xīn péng you , kě shì rú guǒ hǎo bù róng yì zhǎo dào ān jìng shí jiān , páng biān yì zhí yǒu rén shuō huà , wǒ jiù nán yǐ kàn xià qù . zhè bìng bù máo dùn : tóng yī gè rén zài bù tóng shí jiān , yě kě yǐ xiǎng yào bù tóng huó dòng . wǒ yuàn yì zhōu mò cān jiā dú shū jiāo liú , dàn xià kè yǐ hòu de duǎn shí jiān , cháng cháng zhǐ xiǎng ān jìng dú yī huì er .
lines.en: I like discussing books and meeting people, but constant nearby talk impedes quiet reading. Wanting different activities at different times is consistent. I might join a weekend discussion while preferring quiet reading after class.

lines.zh: 如果真要找另外的地方交流，先确认房间能不能用、有没有人负责，再发通知。不能为了让评论里每个人满意，就在没有人接手的时候同时答应两场活动。我看见文章说先继续四周，觉得这个范围清楚；它没有替我解决周四八点半的问题，却给我们一个继续提供意见的时间。
lines.py: rú guǒ zhēn yào zhǎo lìng wài de dì fāng jiāo liú , xiān què rèn fáng jiān néng bù néng yòng , yǒu méi yǒu rén fù zé , zài fā tōng zhī . bù néng wèi le ràng píng lùn lǐ měi gè rén mǎn yì , jiù zài méi yǒu rén jiē shǒu de shí hou tóng shí dā yìng liǎng chǎng huó dòng . wǒ kàn jiàn wén zhāng shuō xiān jì xù sì zhōu , jué de zhè gè fàn wéi qīng chǔ ; tā méi yǒu tì wǒ jiě jué zhōu sì bā diǎn bàn de wèn tí , què gěi wǒ men yī gè jì xù tí gōng yì jiàn de shí jiān .
lines.en: Another discussion venue requires confirmed space and an organiser before notice. Promising two events with no one to run them doesn’t satisfy commenters. Another four-week pilot has a clear scope: it doesn’t solve my 8:30 issue but permits further feedback.

lines.zh: 我后来写给负责人的意见很短：周四有课，八点半才结束，能不能以后考虑别的晚间。我也问了五位同学，有两位愿意周二来，一位星期三方便，另外两位说最近没有时间。负责人回信谢谢我，说会把这些安排和其他反馈放在一起看。我把五个人的回答原样发过去，没有再替没问过的同学填一个时间。
lines.py: wǒ hòu lái xiě gěi fù zé rén de yì jiàn hěn duǎn : zhōu sì yǒu kè , bā diǎn bàn cái jié shù , néng bù néng yǐ hòu kǎo lǜ bié de wǎn jiān . wǒ yě wèn le wǔ wèi tóng xué , yǒu liǎng wèi yuàn yì zhōu èr lái , yī wèi xīng qī sān fāng biàn , lìng wài liǎng wèi shuō zuì jìn méi yǒu shí jiān . fù zé rén huí xìn xiè xiè wǒ , shuō huì bǎ zhè xiē ān pái hé qí tā fǎn kuì fàng zài yì qǐ kàn . wǒ bǎ wǔ gè rén de huí dá yuán yàng fā guò qù , méi yǒu zài tì méi wèn guò de tóng xué tián yī gè shí jiān .
lines.en: My note to the organiser was brief: Thursday class ended at 8:30; could another evening be considered later? I asked five classmates too. Two preferred Tuesday, one Wednesday and two had no time recently. The organiser thanked me and would consider these alongside other feedback. I sent their answers as given, leaving out classmates I hadn't asked.

lines.zh: 负责人回复说，会把这些意见和到访记录放在一起看，先确认下个月的人手。我没有把这句答复理解成已经保证换日期，也没有觉得她一时不能答应就是不重视。她给出了下一步要做的事，我也可以等那个结果出来，再决定是否参加。能把暂时不知道的地方说清楚，反而比马上说什么都可以更可信。
lines.py: fù zé rén huí fù shuō , huì bǎ zhè xiē yì jiàn hé dào fǎng jì lù fàng zài yì qǐ kàn , xiān què rèn xià gè yuè de rén shǒu . wǒ méi yǒu bǎ zhè jù dá fù lǐ jiě chéng yǐ jīng bǎo zhèng huàn rì qī , yě méi yǒu jué de tā yī shí bù néng dā yìng jiù shì bù zhòng shì . tā gěi chū le xià yī bù yào zuò de shì , wǒ yě kě yǐ děng nà gè jié guǒ chū lái , zài jué dìng shì fǒu cān jiā . néng bǎ zàn shí bù zhī dào de dì fāng shuō qīng chǔ , fǎn ér bǐ mǎ shàng shuō shén me dōu kě yǐ gèng kě xìn .
lines.en: The organiser would consider feedback with attendance and check next month’s staff. That is neither a guarantee to change days nor indifference if she cannot promise now. A concrete next step allows a later participation decision; clear uncertainty is more credible than agreeing to everything immediately.

lines.zh: 所以，我赞成继续试，也希望最后的评估不要只留下一个总数。来的人读了什么、没来的人有哪些时间限制、负责的人还能不能继续，这些都不是同一个问题。把它们分开问，不会让讨论失去方向。我们仍然想让阅读方便一些，只是不把一种方便说成所有人的方便，也不把一个人的情况说成唯一答案。
lines.py: suǒ yǐ , wǒ zàn chéng jì xù shì , yě xī wàng zuì hòu de píng gū bú yào zhǐ liú xià yī gè zǒng shù . lái de rén dú le shén me , méi lái de rén yǒu nǎ xiē shí jiān xiàn zhì , fù zé de rén hái néng bù néng jì xù , zhè xiē dōu bù shì tóng yī gè wèn tí . bǎ tā men fēn kāi wèn , bù huì ràng tǎo lùn shī qù fāng xiàng . wǒ men réng rán xiǎng ràng yuè dú fāng biàn yī xiē , zhǐ shì bù bǎ yī zhǒng fāng biàn shuō chéng suǒ yǒu rén de fāng biàn , yě bù bǎ yī gè rén de qíng kuàng shuō chéng wéi yī dá àn .
lines.en: I support further trial and an evaluation beyond one total. Reading needs, non-attendee timing constraints and staff availability are separate questions that can guide the shared aim of convenient reading without pretending one convenience fits all or one person has the sole answer.

pragmatics.note: The condition is part of the position, not a hidden promise.

natural.zh: 你说比重，比较的总人数是多少？
natural.py: nǐ shuō bǐ zhòng , bǐ jiào de zǒng rén shù shì duō shao ?
natural.en: You mention a proportion; what is the total population being compared?

pragmatics.note: Ask what a numeric claim uses as its base.

audio.zh: 工作人员把四个周四的晚间到访分别记为十八、二十、十二和十四人次，共六十四人次。这些记录不包括负责的人。人次说明发生了多少次到访，不等于有六十四个不同的居民。一个人来了三次，就贡献三人次；如果要知道有多少不同的人，需要另一种记录，这次没有做。
audio.py: gōng zuò rén yuán bǎ sì gè zhōu sì de wǎn jiān dào fǎng fēn bié jì wèi shí bā , èr shí , shí èr hé shí sì rén cì , gòng liù shí sì rén cì . zhè xiē jì lù bù bāo kuò fù zé de rén . rén cì shuō míng fā shēng le duō shao cì dào fǎng , bù děng yú yǒu liù shí sì gè bù tóng de jū mín . yī gè rén lái le sān cì , jiù gòng xiàn sān rén cì ; rú guǒ yào zhī dào yǒu duō shao bù tóng de rén , xū yào lìng yī zhǒng jì lù , zhè cì méi yǒu zuò .
audio.en: The four Thursday evenings recorded eighteen, twenty, twelve and fourteen visitor entries, sixty-four total, excluding staff. These are visits rather than sixty-four distinct residents: one person attending three times contributes three. Unique attendance would require a different record that wasn’t kept.

tasks.statement: The record counts visits rather than unique residents.

audio.zh: 延长开放不是没有成本。两位负责的人每次多留两小时，四周合起来是十六小时的人员时间，整理和关门也在这段时间里。这个数字不是两个人各自留了十六小时，更不是每位居民都花了十六小时。下个月能不能继续，先要问两个人的安排，有没有别人接手，不能只看到访者方便，就替负责的人答应。
audio.py: yán cháng kāi fàng bù shì méi yǒu chéng běn . liǎng wèi fù zé de rén měi cì duō liú liǎng xiǎo shí , sì zhōu hé qǐ lái shì shí liù xiǎo shí de rén yuán shí jiān , zhěng lǐ hé guān mén yě zài zhè duàn shí jiān lǐ . zhè gè shù zì bù shì liǎng gè rén gè zì liú le shí liù xiǎo shí , gèng bù shì měi wèi jū mín dōu huā le shí liù xiǎo shí . xià gè yuè néng bù néng jì xù , xiān yào wèn liǎng gè rén de ān pái , yǒu méi yǒu bié ren jiē shǒu , bù néng zhǐ kàn dào fǎng zhě fāng biàn , jiù tì fù zé de rén dā yìng .
audio.en: Two staff each stayed two extra hours per evening: sixteen staff-hours across four weeks, including tidying and closing. It is not sixteen hours for each person or each resident. Next month depends on availability and potential replacements, not a promise made for staff solely because visitors benefit.

tasks.statement: Each of the two staff stayed sixteen extra hours every evening.
tasks.why: Sixteen is the combined four-week staff-hour total.

audio.zh: 我也是这个小图书馆的读者，但没有参加四周的周四晚间试办。不是因为我不需要晚上读书，而是周四有课，结束以后已经八点半。看到有人写“没有来就没有需要”，我想说明自己的情况。开放到八点，对一些人很合适，对我却还是有半小时的差距；这个差距不是一句“不够积极”能消除的。
audio.py: wǒ yě shì zhè gè xiǎo tú shū guǎn de dú zhě , dàn méi yǒu cān jiā sì zhōu de zhōu sì wǎn jiān shì bàn . bù shì yīn wèi wǒ bù xū yào wǎn shang dú shū , ér shì zhōu sì yǒu kè , jié shù yǐ hòu yǐ jīng bā diǎn bàn . kàn dào yǒu rén xiě méi yǒu lái jiù méi yǒu xū yào , wǒ xiǎng shuō míng zì jǐ de qíng kuàng . kāi fàng dào bā diǎn , duì yī xiē rén hěn hé shì , duì wǒ què hái shi yǒu bàn xiǎo shí de chā jù ; zhè gè chā jù bù shì yī jù bù gòu jī jí néng xiāo chú de .
audio.en: I use the small library but didn’t attend the Thursday pilot because class ends at 8:30. Absence doesn’t mean no need for evening reading. Closing at eight suits some but leaves a half-hour gap for me, not a problem solved by calling me insufficiently keen.

tasks.statement: The reader’s class ends after the pilot closes.
tasks.why: Class ends at 8:30 and the library closes at eight.

audio.zh: 负责人回复说，会把这些意见和到访记录放在一起看，先确认下个月的人手。我没有把这句答复理解成已经保证换日期，也没有觉得她一时不能答应就是不重视。她给出了下一步要做的事，我也可以等那个结果出来，再决定是否参加。能把暂时不知道的地方说清楚，反而比马上说什么都可以更可信。
audio.py: fù zé rén huí fù shuō , huì bǎ zhè xiē yì jiàn hé dào fǎng jì lù fàng zài yì qǐ kàn , xiān què rèn xià gè yuè de rén shǒu . wǒ méi yǒu bǎ zhè jù dá fù lǐ jiě chéng yǐ jīng bǎo zhèng huàn rì qī , yě méi yǒu jué de tā yī shí bù néng dā yìng jiù shì bù zhòng shì . tā gěi chū le xià yī bù yào zuò de shì , wǒ yě kě yǐ děng nà gè jié guǒ chū lái , zài jué dìng shì fǒu cān jiā . néng bǎ zàn shí bù zhī dào de dì fāng shuō qīng chǔ , fǎn ér bǐ mǎ shàng shuō shén me dōu kě yǐ gèng kě xìn .
audio.en: The organiser would consider feedback with attendance and check next month’s staff. That is neither a guarantee to change days nor indifference if she cannot promise now. A concrete next step allows a later participation decision; clear uncertainty is more credible than agreeing to everything immediately.

tasks.statement: The reply guarantees a changed date.
tasks.why: It promises to consider records and confirm staffing.

prompt.zh: 一个人来了三次，记录是三人次。能确定是三个不同的人吗？
prompt.py: yī gè rén lái le sān cì , jì lù shì sān rén cì . néng què dìng shì sān gè bù tóng de rén ma ?
prompt.en: One person attended three times, yielding three visits. Does this establish three distinct people?

choices: 不能，是同一个人来了三次。
能，人次一定就是不同的人数。
能，记录明确说三位居民各来一次。
tasks.answer: 不能，是同一个人来了三次。
tasks.why: The premise explicitly identifies a repeat visitor.

prompt.zh: 我支持先继续周四四周，不要求马上每天延长。我的立场是什么？
prompt.py: wǒ zhī chí xiān jì xù zhōu sì sì zhōu , bú yào qiú mǎ shàng měi tiān yán cháng . wǒ de lì chǎng shì shén me ?
prompt.en: I support four further Thursdays, without immediate daily extension. What is my position?

choices: 有条件地继续试周四。
马上永久延长每一天。
任何周四都必须立刻关闭。
tasks.why: Keep the stated scope and conditions.

prompt.zh: 总读者人数没提供，可以算到访者的比重吗？
prompt.py: zǒng dú zhě rén shù méi tí gōng , kě yǐ suàn dào fǎng zhě de bǐ zhòng ma ?
prompt.en: The total number of readers is absent. Can we calculate visitors’ share?

choices: 不能，还缺总人数。
可以，六十四已经告诉我们全部读者。
可以，没到场的人就不算读者。

line.zh: 只看总人数，这个依据太【单一】。
line.py: zhǐ kàn zǒng rén shù , zhè gè yī jù tài dān yī .
line.en: Total attendance alone is too one-dimensional a basis.

line.zh: 还不能【排除】天气影响人数。
line.py: hái bù néng pái chú tiān qì yǐng xiǎng rén shù .
line.en: We cannot yet rule out the weather affecting attendance.

line.zh: 我们【依据】到访记录和意见作评估。
line.py: wǒ men yī jù dào fǎng jì lù hé yì jiàn zuò píng gū .
line.en: We evaluate using visit records and feedback.
